song.name: Stormbringer
song.plot: Anya, cast through the Great Rift, comes to wield Vorgos's storm-forged power. She carries his might as his vessel — never claiming his title — and turns the storm against the coming darkness.
song.analysis: Full original structure restored (9 sections, nothing cut). KEY CANON FIX: Anya wields Vorgos's power but never claims his title — chorus POV reworked from "I am the stormbringer" to "I wield the Stormbringer's might, master of fate" / "I am the storm's vessel, the breaker of chains", and the outro fades on "Vorgos's power is mine". The Bridge anchors the Void ("The lightning strikes, the Void quakes"). All other lines verbatim, syllable counts matched line-for-line. Suggested Suno direction: driving rock power ballad — galloping drums, wailing guitars, thunder.
